messages: Hey, did you end up submitting that report we talked about?
I asked you specifically to handle that by Tuesday and now it's Thursday. What happened?
I'm not trying to be difficult but this is the second time this month. It affects the whole team.
Don't tell me you were busy, everyone is busy. I stayed late three nights to finish my part.
You know what, I'm done covering for you. I'm telling the manager exactly what happened.
No, I'm not overreacting. You keep saying sorry and nothing actually changes.
This conversation is pointless. I'll handle it myself like I always do.
Fine. But don't expect me to share credit on the next project.
I mean it this time. I'm done.
Just leave me alone right now.
